# Cloud Calendars

> Calendar views and weather for iPhone and iPad, developed by ARTE SOFT EOOD. Connect supported calendars while keeping their ownership and permissions distinct.

## Product

- [Cloud Calendars](https://www.cloud-calendars.com/): calendar views, weather, Home Screen widgets and plan information.
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cloud-calendars-sync-widget/id6744690319): current version, availability, local pricing and supported devices.
- [Calendar comparisons hub](https://www.cloud-calendars.com/compare/): multi-table comparisons across iPhone calendar apps, unified account views, CalDAV vs ICS vs native OAuth sync, and shared household setups.

## Capabilities and limits

- Day, Week, Month, Year and List views, including a multi-calendar side-by-side day overview.
- Base (Free) includes iCloud/device calendar access, Google Calendar sync, Google Meet support, Apple WeatherKit forecasts and Home Screen widgets. Advanced removes ads. Premium adds Microsoft Calendar (Outlook / Exchange / Microsoft 365) and Microsoft Teams support.
- Local calendars can be used on the device without an app account. Provider connections and sharing services may require sign-in and the appropriate permissions.
- Available weather depends on location, dates and Apple WeatherKit (up to 10 returned daily forecast days plus hourly forecasts). A month of calendar dates is not a month of available forecasts.
- Read-only calendars and subscribed ICS feeds remain read-only; a subscription does not override calendar-owner or workplace restrictions, nor does a combined view automatically copy busy blocks between separate accounts.

Requires iOS / iPadOS 18.0 or later on iPhone and iPad. Check current local subscription terms before purchase. This website contains English comparisons, guides and translations; only existing versions are linked.
